title: Put slot A back as the active slot
body: An earlier run of the installer measured this Pixel 7 Pro's second bootloader copy and did not finish, so slot B may still be its active slot.
The installer can make slot A the active slot again, restart the phone into its bootloader if slot B's runs now, and look at it again. Nothing is written to the phone's partitions.

steps.text: Or do it yourself, with Android's fastboot tool and the phone in Fastboot Mode:

footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is in this run. It sends nothing more before you answer.

choices.label: Make slot A active again (at most one restart into the bootloader)
